# Teach Starter

> > Teach Starter is a comprehensive platform providing elementary teachers with printable worksheets, lesson plans, games, and classroom activities aligned to K-5 curriculum standards.

Teach Starter offers a vast library of teaching resources organized by subject area (ELA, Math, Science, Social Studies, Health, Fine Arts, Languages, and Social-Emotional Learning) and grade level (Pre-K through K-12). The platform includes interactive activities, printable materials compatible with Google Slides, Microsoft Word, and PDF formats, and subscription plans for expanded access to premium content.

## Key Topics

- Elementary Teaching Resources
- Printable Worksheets
- Lesson Plans
- Classroom Activities
- English Language Arts (ELA)
- Mathematics
- Science & STEM
- Social Studies

- Grade Levels (K-5)
- Google Slides
- Microsoft Word & PowerPoint
- Curriculum-Aligned
- Teacher Resources
- Interactive Games

## Core Platform

- [Teach Starter Homepage](https://www.teachstarter.com): Teach Starter homepage offering elementary teaching resources, lesson plans, and classroom activities.
- [US Portal](https://www.teachstarter.com/us): US-focused Teach Starter portal with holiday lessons and classroom teaching materials.
- [Teaching Resources Library](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/teaching-resources): Teach Starter main library of printables, games, worksheets, and educational activities.
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/plans): Teach Starter pricing plans and subscription tiers for teacher resource access.

## Learning Areas by Subject

- [English Language Arts Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/elar-us): ELA worksheets, grammar activities, and reading comprehension resources for K-5.
- [Mathematics Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/mathematics-us): Elementary math printables, interactive games, and lesson plans for K-5 grades.
- [Science & STEM Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/science-us): Science worksheets, STEM activities, and inquiry-based learning resources for K-5.
- [Social Studies Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/social-studies-us): US history worksheets and cross-curricular social studies resources for grades 2-5.
- [Social-Emotional Learning Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/social-emotional-learning-us): SEL activities, mindfulness, and goal-setting resources for elementary classrooms.
- [Health Education Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/health-us): Health education posters, worksheets, and life skills activities for elementary grades.
- [Fine Arts & Special Areas Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/fine-arts-us): Art, music, and technology teaching resources and drawing lessons for K-12 educators.
- [Languages Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/languages-other-than-american-english): Spanish, German, and bilingual classroom resources including flashcards and vocabulary.

## Resources by Grade Level

- [Grade Levels Directory](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-levels): Teach Starter resource navigation by grade level from Pre-K through K-12.
- [Pre-K Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/pre-kindergarten): Pre-K worksheets, sight words, and early literacy activities for preschool educators.
- [Kindergarten Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/kindergarten): Kindergarten phonics, math games, and interactive activities for early learners.
- [1st Grade Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/grade-1): First-grade sight words, math worksheets, and phonics resources for grade 1 teachers.
- [2nd Grade Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/grade-2): Second-grade math, spelling, and ELA resources for elementary curriculum planning.
- [3rd Grade Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/grade-3): Third-grade worksheets, math activities, and subject-based learning materials.

- [Learning Areas Directory](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-areas): Teach Starter resource directory organized by 8 curriculum subject categories.
